variants.name: coastal-dunes
variants.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Make one photorealistic game terrain concept using input ONLY as exact geometry template. Preserve aspect ratio, framing, both slope lines and endpoints, opening at y39%, narrow channel inner boundaries x44%-55%, depth, bottom at y89%, base sill footprint. Camera slightly looking upward, lighting sunlight FROM LEFT. CRITICAL replace the masonry construction entirely: NO stacked bricks, no block columns, no tiled rear wall, no mortar seams. Channel sides are continuous exposed natural cut faces of terrain with physical thickness, rear wall is continuous recessed material with occlusion and contact shadows showing depth. Clean broad realistic surfaces, restrained natural detail. Same transparent alpha sky opening. No text, UI, bag, fruit, no extra obstacles. Full single terrain, not collage. Coastal dune cutaway: warm pale beige consolidated sand banks with smoothly wind-worn surfaces, sparse coastal dune grasses along slope crest. Narrow channel edged by continuous weathered sandy cut faces, deeper back wall a single naturally eroded pale sandstone exposure, cooler and darker in recess. Rounded sandstone sill. Thin sand strip bottom. Convincing real sand and sediment, not granular noise, no ocean in opening, no decorative shells.
